description: This file provides localization (translations) for the Select2 jQuery plugin in the Malay language (ms). It defines various user interface messages used by the plugin, such as error messages, loading indicators, and prompts.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to delete excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message showing the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no matching results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
